name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.deckAct_mul
statement:
lemma deckAct_mul (c : C) (δ : D →* Aut c) (d e : D) (x : F.obj c) :
    deckAct (F := F) c δ (d * e) x = deckAct c δ d (deckAct c δ e x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deckAct, map_mul, Aut.Aut_mul_def, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.map_comp_apply]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.deckAct_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma deckAct_one (c : C) (δ : D →* Aut c) (x : F.obj c) :
    deckAct (F := F) c δ 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deckAct, map_one]
  exact Functor.map_id_apply F c x

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.app_deckAct
statement:
lemma app_deckAct (α : FibreAut F) (c : C) (δ : D →* Aut c) (d : D) (x : F.obj c) :
    α.app c (deckAct c δ d x) = deckAct c δ d (α.app c x)
proof:
:=
  app_naturality α _ x

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.deckAct_deckCharacterFun
statement:
lemma deckAct_deckCharacterFun (α : FibreAut F) :
    deckAct c δ (deckCharacterFun c δ x₀ h α) x₀ = α.app c x₀
proof:
:=
  (h x₀ (α.app c x₀)).exists.choose_spec

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.deckCharacterFun_eq
statement:
lemma deckCharacterFun_eq {α : FibreAut F} {d : D} (hd : deckAct c δ d x₀ = α.app c x₀) :
    deckCharacterFun c δ x₀ h α = d
proof:
:=
  (h x₀ (α.app c x₀)).unique (deckAct_deckCharacterFun c δ x₀ h α) hd

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.deckAct_deckCharacter
statement:
lemma deckAct_deckCharacter (α : FibreAut F) :
    deckAct c δ (deckCharacter c δ x₀ h α) x₀ = α.app c x₀
proof:
:=
  deckAct_deckCharacterFun c δ x₀ h α

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.continuous_deckCharacter
statement:
lemma continuous_deckCharacter [TopologicalSpace D] [DiscreteTopology D] :
    Continuous (deckCharacter c δ x₀ h)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsOpen ((deckCharacter c δ x₀ h).ker : Set (FibreAut F)) := by
    refine Subgroup.isOpen_mono (H₁ := stabilizer F {⟨c, x₀⟩}) ?_ (isOpen_stabilizer F _)
    intro α hα
    have hα' : α.app c x₀ = x₀ := hα ⟨c, x₀⟩ (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
    exact deckCharacterFun_eq c δ x₀ h (by rw [hα']; simp)
  exact continuous_of_continuousAt_one _
    (by rw [ContinuousAt, map_one]
        exact tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq (Filter.mem_of_superset
          (this.mem_nhds (Subgroup.one_mem _)) fun α hα => hα))

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.deckCharacter_surjective_iff
statement:
lemma deckCharacter_surjective_iff :
    Function.Surjective (deckCharacter c δ x₀ h) ↔
      ∀ d : D, ∃ α : FibreAut F, α.app c x₀ = deckAct c δ d x₀
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs d
    obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := hs d
    exact ⟨α, (deckAct_deckCharacter c δ x₀ h α).symm⟩
  · intro hs d
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hs d
    exact ⟨α, deckCharacterFun_eq c δ x₀ h hα.symm⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.transported_hom_apply
statement:
lemma transported_hom_apply (β : FibreAut Φ) (c : C) (x : F.obj (R.obj c)) :
    (transported R e β c).hom x = e.inv.app c (β.app c (e.hom.app c x))
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.transported_naturality
statement:
lemma transported_naturality (β : FibreAut Φ) {c c' : C} (m : c ⟶ c') (x : F.obj (R.obj c)) :
    (transported R e β c').hom (F.map (R.map m) x) =
      F.map (R.map m) ((transported R e β c).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transported_hom_apply, transported_hom_apply]
  have h₁ := NatTrans.naturality_apply e.hom m x
  have h₂ := NatTrans.naturality_apply e.inv m (β.app c (e.hom.app c x))
  simp only [Functor.comp_map] at h₁ h₂
  rw [h₁, app_naturality, ← h₂]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.transported_naturality'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c'', m, m', hm, hmu⟩ := hR.refine u
  
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, F.map (R.map m) y = x :=
    ⟨F.map (inv (R.map m)) x, by rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id,
      Functor.map_id_apply]⟩
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, hmu, transported_naturality, transported_naturality,
    ← Functor.map_comp_apply, hmu]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.transported_conj
statement:
lemma transported_conj (hR : IsRealization R) (β : FibreAut Φ) {c c' : C} {d d' : D}
    (i : R.obj c ≅ d) (i' : R.obj c' ≅ d') (f : d ⟶ d') (x : F.obj d) :
    F.map i'.hom ((transported R e β c').hom (F.map i'.inv (F.map f x))) =
      F.map f (F.map i.hom ((transported R e β c).hom (F.map i.inv x)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := transported_naturality' e hR β (i.hom ≫ f ≫ i'.inv) (F.map i.inv x)
  have h1 : F.map (i.hom ≫ f ≫ i'.inv) (F.map i.inv x) = F.map i'.inv (F.map f x) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    simp
  rw [h1] at h
  rw [h, ← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  simp

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.extend_app
statement:
lemma extend_app (hR : IsRealization R) (β : FibreAut Φ) (d : D) (x : F.obj d) :
    (extend R e hR β).app d x =
      F.map (hR.essSurj d).choose_spec.some.hom
        ((transported R e β (hR.essSurj d).choose).hom
          (F.map (hR.essSurj d).choose_spec.some.inv x))
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.restrict_extend
statement:
lemma restrict_extend (hR : IsRealization R) (β : FibreAut Φ) :
    restrict R e (extend R e hR β) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext c x
  rw [restrict_app, extend_app]
  set i := (hR.essSurj (R.obj c)).choose_spec.some
  rw [transported_naturality' e hR β i.inv, ← Functor.map_comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Functor.map_id_apply, transported_hom_apply]
  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.restrict_injective
statement: lemma restrict_injective (hR : IsRealization R) : Function.Injective (restrict R e)
proof:
:= by
  intro α β h
  ext d x
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨i⟩⟩ := hR.essSurj d
  have hc : ∀ y, α.app (R.obj c) y = β.app (R.obj c) y := by
    intro y
    have := congrArg (fun σ : FibreAut Φ => σ.app c (e.hom.app c y)) h
    simp only [restrict_app, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_apply] at this
    have := congrArg (e.inv.app c) this
    simpa only [Iso.hom_inv_id_app_apply] using this
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, F.map i.hom y = x :=
    ⟨F.map i.inv x, by rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id, Functor.map_id_apply]⟩
  rw [app_naturality, app_naturality, hc]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.restrict_bijective_of_isRealization
statement:
lemma restrict_bijective_of_isRealization (hR : IsRealization R) :
    Function.Bijective (restrict R e)
proof:
:=
  ⟨restrict_injective R e hR, fun β => ⟨extend R e hR β, restrict_extend R e hR β⟩⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.restrictEquivOfIsRealization_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrictEquivOfIsRealization_apply (hR : IsRealization R) (σ : FibreAut F) :

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.FibreAut.isRealization_of_full
statement:
lemma isRealization_of_full (R : C ⥤ D) [R.EssSurj] [R.Full] : IsRealization R where

proof:
:= ⟨R.objPreimage d, ⟨R.objObjPreimageIso d⟩⟩
  refine {c c'} u := ⟨c, 𝟙 c, R.preimage u, by rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]; infer_instance,

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.bijective_algebraMap_projSpace
statement:
lemma bijective_algebraMap_projSpace (m : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) R 0))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b h ↦ ?_, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simpa using this
  · have hp : (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) R) ∈ (1 : Submodule R _) := by
      rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_zero]
      exact p.2
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hp
    exact ⟨r, Subtype.ext hr⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.isHomogeneous_fin_one
statement:
lemma isHomogeneous_fin_one {p : MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous n) :
    p = C (coeff (Finsupp.single 0 n) p) * X 0 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow]
  by_cases hd : Finsupp.single 0 n = d
  · subst hd
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hd, mul_zero]
    refine hp.coeff_eq_zero fun h ↦ hd ?_
    ext i
    rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i, Finsupp.single_eq_same, ← h]
    simp [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.X_zero_mem_homogeneousSubmodule
statement:
lemma X_zero_mem_homogeneousSubmodule :
    (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R) ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (0 + 1)) R 1
proof:
:=
  isHomogeneous_X R 0

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.X_zero_not_mem
statement:
lemma X_zero_not_mem (x : projSpace R 0) :
    (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R) ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply x.not_irrelevant_le
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi a ha
  change a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (0 + 1)) R i at ha
  change a ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
  rw [isHomogeneous_fin_one ha]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ h i hi)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.bijective_fromZeroRingHom_projSpace_zero
statement:
lemma bijective_fromZeroRingHom_projSpace_zero :
    Function.Bijective (fromZeroRingHom (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (0 + 1)) R)
      (Submonoid.powers (X 0)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b h ↦ ?_, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h' := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val h
    have hle : Submonoid.powers (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R) ≤
        nonZeroDivisors _ := by
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact (isRegular_X_pow k).mem_nonZeroDivisors
    have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R)
        (Localization.Away (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R))) :=
      IsLocalization.injective _ hle
    refine Subtype.ext (hinj ?_)
    rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
    exact h'
  · obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (0 + 1)) R)
      X_zero_mem_homogeneousSubmodule z
    have ha' : a.IsHomogeneous n := by simpa using ha
    refine ⟨⟨C (coeff (Finsupp.single 0 n) a), isHomogeneous_C _ _⟩, ?_⟩
    apply val_injective
    rw [Away.val_mk]
    change Localization.mk _ 1 = _
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    conv_rhs => rw [isHomogeneous_fin_one ha']
    simp [mul_comm]

statement:
lemma spLift_fac_left [UniversallyClosed f] (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ X)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.spLift_unique
statement:
lemma spLift_unique [UniversallyClosed f] [IsSeparated f] (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (hx : x ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (valToField O)))
    (ℓ : Spec (CommRingCat.of V) ⟶ X)
    (h₁ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap V Ω)) ≫ ℓ = x)
    (h₂ : ℓ ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (valToVal O V hV))) :
    ℓ = (spLift (hV := hV) x hx).l
proof:
:= by
  have := IsSeparated.valuativeCriterion f (spSquare O V hV f x hx)
  exact congrArg CommSq.LiftStruct.l (Subsingleton.elim (⟨ℓ, h₁, h₂⟩ :
    (spSquare O V hV f x hx).commSq.LiftStruct) _)

    (spLift (hV := hV) x hx).l (closedPoint V) ∈ specialFibre f

lemma sp_eq_of_lift [UniversallyClosed f] [IsSeparated f] (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (hx : x ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (valToField O)))
    (ℓ : Spec (CommRingCat.of V) ⟶ X)
    (h₁ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap V Ω)) ≫ ℓ = x)
    (h₂ : ℓ ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (valToVal O V hV))) :
    (sp f V hV x hx : X) = ℓ (closedPoint V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spLift_unique x hx ℓ h₁ h₂]
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.sp_comp
statement:
lemma sp_comp {X' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of O)}
    [UniversallyClosed f] [IsSeparated f] [UniversallyClosed f'] [IsSeparated f']
    (ψ : X ⟶ X') (hψ : ψ ≫ f' = f) (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (hx : x ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (valToField O))) :
    sp f' V hV (x ≫ ψ) (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ, hx]) =
      specialFibreMap ψ hψ (sp f V hV x hx)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [sp_eq_of_lift (x ≫ ψ) _ ((spLift (hV := hV) x hx).l ≫ ψ)
    (by rw [← Category.assoc, spLift_fac_left])
    (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ]; exact spLift_fac_right x hx)]
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.coe_sp_comp
statement:
lemma coe_sp_comp {X' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of O)}
    [UniversallyClosed f] [IsSeparated f] [UniversallyClosed f'] [IsSeparated f']
    (ψ : X ⟶ X') (hψ : ψ ≫ f' = f) (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (hx : x ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (valToField O))) :
    (sp f' V hV (x ≫ ψ) (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ, hx]) : X') = ψ (sp f V hV x hx)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sp_comp ψ hψ]
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.sp_galois
statement:
lemma sp_galois [UniversallyClosed f] [IsSeparated f] (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
    (hσ : ∀ x, σ x ∈ V ↔ x ∈ V) (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (hx : x ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (valToField O))) :
    sp f V hV (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (σ : Ω →+* Ω)) ≫ x) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, hx, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
      congr 2
      ext a
      simp [valToField]) = sp f V hV x hx
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [sp_eq_of_lift _ _ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (restrictVal σ hσ)) ≫
    (spLift (hV := hV) x hx).l)]
  · change (spLift (hV := hV) x hx).l _ = (spLift (hV := hV) x hx).l _
    congr 1
    exact comap_closedPoint (restrictVal σ hσ)
  · have e : (algebraMap V Ω).comp (restrictVal σ hσ) = (σ : Ω →+* Ω).comp (algebraMap V Ω) := by
      ext; rfl
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, e,
      CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, spLift_fac_left]
  · have e : (restrictVal σ hσ).comp (valToVal O V hV) = valToVal O V hV := by
      ext a
      exact σ.commutes (a : K)
    rw [Category.assoc]
    refine (congrArg (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (restrictVal σ hσ)) ≫ ·)
      (spLift_fac_right (hV := hV) x hx)).trans ?_
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, e]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_map_eq_or_neg
statement:
lemma exists_map_eq_or_neg {P Q : GeomPoint W} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0)
    (h : aeval (xOf Q) (minpoly k (xOf P)) = 0) :
    ∃ σ : AlgebraicClosure k ≃ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k,
      Q = Point.map (σ : AlgebraicClosure k →ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k) P ∨
        Q = -Point.map (σ : AlgebraicClosure k →ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k) P
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IsIntegral k (xOf P) := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _
  have hmin : minpoly k (xOf Q) = minpoly k (xOf P) :=
    (minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic (minpoly.irreducible hint) h (minpoly.monic hint)).symm
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp
    ((Normal.minpoly_eq_iff_mem_orbit (AlgebraicClosure k)).mp hmin)
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  have hσP : Point.map (σ : AlgebraicClosure k →ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k) P ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Ne, map_eq_zero_iff]
  rw [eq_some_xOf_yOf hQ, eq_some_xOf_yOf hσP]
  refine Point.X_eq_iff.mp ?_
  rw [xOf_map, ← hσ]
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_polynomial_zeroSet
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_zeroSet {𝒮 : Set (GeomPoint W)} (hfin : 𝒮.Finite)
    (hneg : ∀ P ∈ 𝒮, -P ∈ 𝒮) (hgal : IsGaloisStable W 𝒮) :
    ∃ Ψ : k[X], Ψ ≠ 0 ∧
      zeroSet W (algebraMap k[X] W.toAffine.CoordinateRing Ψ) = 𝒮 \ {0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s := hfin.toFinset.filter (· ≠ 0)
  refine ⟨∏ P ∈ s, minpoly k (xOf P), Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun P _ =>
    minpoly.ne_zero (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _), ?_⟩
  ext Q
  simp only [mem_zeroSet, evalPt_algebraMap_polynomial, map_prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff,
    Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, s, Finset.mem_filter, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hQ, P, ⟨hP𝒮, hP⟩, h⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hQ⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, rfl | rfl⟩ := exists_map_eq_or_neg hP hQ h
    exacts [hgal σ P hP𝒮, hneg _ (hgal σ P hP𝒮)]
  · rintro ⟨hQ𝒮, hQ⟩
    exact ⟨hQ, Q, ⟨hQ𝒮, hQ⟩, minpoly.aeval k _⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_algHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem exists_algHom_eq_zero_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [Algebra.FiniteType k R]
    (𝔪 : Ideal R) [𝔪.IsMaximal] :
    ∃ χ : R →ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k, ∀ r, χ r = 0 ↔ r ∈ 𝔪
proof:
:= by
  letI : Field (R ⧸ 𝔪) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔪
  haveI : Module.Finite k (R ⧸ 𝔪) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing k (R ⧸ 𝔪)
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (R ⧸ 𝔪) := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite k _
  refine ⟨(IsAlgClosed.lift : (R ⧸ 𝔪) →ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k).comp
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k 𝔪), fun r => ?_⟩
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_eq_zero, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_pow_mem_span_of_zeroSet_subset
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mem_span_of_zeroSet_subset {h D : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing}
    (hsub : zeroSet W h ⊆ zeroSet W D) : ∃ n : ℕ, D ^ n ∈ Ideal.span {h}
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsJacobsonRing W.toAffine.CoordinateRing := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := k)
  have : D ∈ (Ideal.span {h}).jacobson := by
    refine Ideal.mem_sInf.mpr fun 𝔪 ⟨hle, h𝔪⟩ => ?_
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_zero_iff (k := k) 𝔪
    have hχh : χ h = 0 := (hχ h).mpr (hle (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self h))
    obtain ⟨_, hD⟩ := hsub ⟨pointOfC_ne_zero χ, by rw [evalPt_pointOfC]; exact hχh⟩
    rw [evalPt_pointOfC] at hD
    exact (hχ D).mp hD
  rwa [← Ideal.radical_eq_jacobson] at this

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringAway_eq_range
statement:
theorem ringAway_eq_range (hD : D ≠ 0) (h𝒮 : zeroSet W D = 𝒮 \ {0}) :
    ringAway W 𝒮 = (locMap D hD).range
proof:
:= by
  have hD𝒮 : zeroSet W D ⊆ 𝒮 := h𝒮 ▸ Set.sdiff_subset
  refine le_antisymm (ringAway_le (algebraMap_mem_range_locMap hD) fun h hh => ?_) ?_
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_mem_span_of_zeroSet_subset (h := h) (D := D)
      fun Q hQ => h𝒮 ▸ ⟨hh hQ, ne_zero_of_mem_zeroSet hQ⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hn
    have hι := congrArg (algebraMap _ (funField W)) hb
    rw [map_mul, map_pow] at hι
    have hne : algebraMap _ (funField W) D ^ n ≠ 0 :=
      pow_ne_zero _ ((_root_.map_ne_zero_iff _ (injective_algebraMap_funField W)).mpr hD)
    rw [← hι] at hne
    refine (mem_range_locMap hD).mpr ⟨b, n, ?_⟩
    rw [inv_pow, ← hι, mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (left_ne_zero_of_mul hne), one_mul]
  · intro f hf
    obtain ⟨a, n, rfl⟩ := (mem_range_locMap hD).mp hf
    exact mul_mem (algebraMap_mem_ringAway a) (pow_mem (inv_mem_ringAway hD𝒮) n)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coe_ringAwayEquiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_ringAwayEquiv (hD : D ≠ 0) (h𝒮 : zeroSet W D = 𝒮 \ {0})
    (z : Localization.Away D) : (ringAwayEquiv hD h𝒮 z : funField W) = locMap D hD z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringAwayEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
lemma ringAwayEquiv_algebraMap (hD : D ≠ 0) (h𝒮 : zeroSet W D = 𝒮 \ {0})
    (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    (ringAwayEquiv hD h𝒮 (algebraMap _ _ c) : funField W) = algebraMap _ (funField W) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_ringAwayEquiv, locMap_algebraMap]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coe_algebraMap_ringAway
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_algebraMap_ringAway (𝒮 : Set (GeomPoint W)) (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    (algebraMap W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (ringAway W 𝒮) c : funField W) =
      algebraMap _ (funField W) c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.isLocalization_away_ringAway
statement:
theorem isLocalization_away_ringAway {𝒮 : Set (GeomPoint W)} {D : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing}
    (hD : D ≠ 0) (h𝒮 : zeroSet W D = 𝒮 \ {0}) : IsLocalization.Away D (ringAway W 𝒮)
proof:
:= by
  have hD𝒮 : zeroSet W D ⊆ 𝒮 := h𝒮 ▸ Set.sdiff_subset
  have hιD : algebraMap _ (funField W) D ≠ 0 :=
    (_root_.map_ne_zero_iff _ (injective_algebraMap_funField W)).mpr hD
  refine IsLocalization.Away.mk D ?_ (fun s => ?_) (fun a b hab => ⟨0, ?_⟩)
  · exact isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr
      ⟨⟨_, inv_mem_ringAway hD𝒮⟩, Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel₀ hιD)⟩
  · have hs : (s : funField W) ∈ (locMap D hD).range := ringAway_eq_range hD h𝒮 ▸ s.2
    obtain ⟨a, n, hs⟩ := (mem_range_locMap hD).mp hs
    refine ⟨n, a, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, coe_algebraMap_ringAway,
      coe_algebraMap_ringAway, hs, inv_pow, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hιD),
      mul_one]
  · rw [pow_zero, one_mul, one_mul]
    exact injective_algebraMap_funField W (congrArg Subtype.val hab)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.map_bc
statement:
lemma map_bc {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra k K] (φ : L →ₐ[k] K)
    (P : W.toAffine.Point) :
    Point.map φ (bc W L P) = bc W K P
proof:
:= by
  have := Point.map_map (W' := W.toAffine) (Algebra.ofId k L) φ P
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (φ.comp (Algebra.ofId k L)) (Algebra.ofId k K)] at this
  exact this

lemma map_units_smul {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra k K] (φ : L →ₐ[k] K) (ε : ℤˣ)

lemma algebraMap_funField (a : k) : algebraMap k (funField W) a =
    algebraMap W.toAffine.CoordinateRing _ (AdjoinRoot.mk W.toAffine.polynomial (C (C a)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k W.toAffine.CoordinateRing]
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.equation_gen
statement: lemma equation_gen : (W.toAffine⁄(funField W)).Equation (xGen W) (yGen W)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : AdjoinRoot.mk W.toAffine.polynomial (Y ^ 2 + C (C W.a₁ * X + C W.a₃) * Y -
      C (X ^ 3 + C W.a₂ * X ^ 2 + C W.a₄ * X + C W.a₆)) = 0 := AdjoinRoot.mk_self
  have h := congrArg (algebraMap W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (funField W)) h0
  rw [equation_iff]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero] at h
  simp only [xGen, yGen, WeierstrassCurve.baseChange, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₁,
    WeierstrassCurve.map_a₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₃, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.map_a₆, algebraMap_funField]
  linear_combination h

lemma nonsingular_of_equation [W.IsElliptic] {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra k L] {x y : L}

proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W.toAffine⁄L).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap k L)).IsElliptic
  exact equation_iff_nonsingular.mp h

statement:
lemma aeval_xGen (p : k[X]) : aeval (xGen W) p =
    algebraMap W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (funField W)
      (AdjoinRoot.mk W.toAffine.polynomial (C p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [xGen, ← IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom' k, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply]
  congr 1
  rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_C, ← AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, aeval_algebraMap_apply, aeval_X_left_apply,
    AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_C]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.transcendental_xGen
statement: lemma transcendental_xGen : Transcendental k (xGen W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transcendental_iff_injective]
  intro p q h
  simp only [aeval_xGen] at h
  have := IsFractionRing.injective W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (funField W) h
  rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_C, AdjoinRoot.mk_C] at this
  exact AdjoinRoot.of.injective_of_degree_ne_zero
    (by rw [W.toAffine.degree_polynomial]; decide) this

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.injective_evalHom
statement:
lemma injective_evalHom (x y : L) (h : (W.toAffine⁄L).Equation x y) (hx : Transcendental k x) :
    Function.Injective (evalHom W x y h)
proof:
:= by
  have hker : RingHom.ker (evalHom W x y h) = ⊥ := by
    apply Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot (R := k[X])
    refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun p hp => ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq, evalHom_of] at hp
    by_contra hp0
    exact hx ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩
  exact (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mpr hker

statement:

:= by

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.algHom_ext_funField
statement:
lemma algHom_ext_funField {φ ψ : funField W →ₐ[k] L} (hx : φ (xGen W) = ψ (xGen W))
    (hy : φ (yGen W) = ψ (yGen W)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (funField W)) =
      ψ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (funField W)) := by
    apply AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext'
    · apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
      change φ (algebraMap _ _ (AdjoinRoot.of _ X)) = ψ (algebraMap _ _ (AdjoinRoot.of _ X))
      rw [← AdjoinRoot.mk_C]
      exact hx
    · exact hy
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  exact IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := W.toAffine.CoordinateRing)
    fun c => DFunLike.congr_fun hc c

proof:
:= by
  apply algHom_ext_funField
  · rw [← xOf_map_genericPoint, h, xOf_map_genericPoint]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.map_liftFF_genericPoint
statement:
lemma map_liftFF_genericPoint {P : (W.toAffine⁄L).Point} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hx : Transcendental k (xOf P)) :
    Point.map (liftFF (xOf P) (yOf P) (equation_xOf_yOf hP) hx) (genericPoint W) = P
proof:
:= by
  refine Point.ext_xOf_yOf ?_ hP ?_ ?_
  · exact fun h => genericPoint_ne_zero W ((map_eq_zero_iff _).mp h)
  · rw [xOf_map_genericPoint, liftFF_xGen]
  · rw [yOf_map_genericPoint, liftFF_yGen]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.AffAut.map_act
statement:
lemma map_act {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra k K] (φ : L →ₐ[k] K) (g : AffAut W)
    (P : (W.toAffine⁄L).Point) : Point.map φ (g.act L P) = g.act K (Point.map φ P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [act_def, act_def, map_add, map_units_smul, map_bc]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.AffAut.smul_def
statement: lemma smul_def (g : AffAut W) (P : W.toAffine.Point) : g • P = g.ε • P + g.m
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.AffAut.bc_smul
statement: lemma bc_smul (g : AffAut W) (P : W.toAffine.Point) : bc W L (g • P) = g.act L (bc W L P)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.mem_range_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
lemma mem_range_of_isAlgebraic {Q : (W.toAffine⁄(funField W)).Point}
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0 → IsAlgebraic k (xOf Q)) : Q ∈ Set.range (Point.map (K₀).val)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hQ0 : Q = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [hQ0, map_zero]⟩
  have hx : xOf Q ∈ K₀ := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr (hQ hQ0)
  set x : K₀ := ⟨xOf Q, hx⟩
  have hns := nonsingular_xOf_yOf hQ0
  have hy : IsAlgebraic k (yOf Q) := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : K₀, b = algebraMap k K₀ W.a₁ * x + algebraMap k K₀ W.a₃ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : K₀, c = x ^ 3 + algebraMap k K₀ W.a₂ * x ^ 2 +
      algebraMap k K₀ W.a₄ * x + algebraMap k K₀ W.a₆ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    let p : (K₀)[X] := X ^ 2 + C b * X - C c
    have hp : p ≠ 0 := fun h => by simpa [p] using congrArg (coeff · 2) h
    have hpy : aeval (yOf Q) p = 0 := by
      have := (equation_iff _ _).mp hns.1
      simp only [WeierstrassCurve.baseChange, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₁, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₂,
        WeierstrassCurve.map_a₃, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₄, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₆] at this
      simp only [p, hb, hc, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C,
        IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply, IntermediateField.coe_algebraMap_apply, x]
      linear_combination this
    exact IsAlgebraic.restrictScalars k ⟨p, hp, hpy⟩
  set y : K₀ := ⟨yOf Q, mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr hy⟩
  have hns' : (W.toAffine⁄K₀).Nonsingular x y :=
    (W.toAffine.baseChange_nonsingular (f := (K₀).val) Subtype.val_injective x y).mp hns
  refine ⟨.some x y hns', Point.ext_xOf_yOf ?_ hQ0 rfl rfl⟩
  rw [Ne, map_eq_zero_iff]
  exact Point.some_ne_zero _

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.genericPoint_notMem_range
statement: lemma genericPoint_notMem_range : genericPoint W ∉ Set.range (Point.map (K₀).val)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨Q, hQ⟩
  have hx : xGen W = (K₀).val (xOf Q) := by
    rw [← xOf_genericPoint, ← hQ]
    exact xOf_map _ Q
  apply transcendental_xGen W
  rw [hx]
  exact mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp (xOf Q).2

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.act_genericPoint_ne_zero_and
statement:
lemma act_genericPoint_ne_zero_and (g : AffAut W) :
    g.act _ (genericPoint W) ≠ 0 ∧ Transcendental k (xOf (g.act _ (genericPoint W)))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  rw [not_and_or, not_not, Transcendental, not_not] at h
  have hmem := mem_range_of_isAlgebraic W (Q := g.act _ (genericPoint W))
    fun h0 => h.resolve_left h0
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hmem
  apply genericPoint_notMem_range W
  refine ⟨g⁻¹.act _ Q, ?_⟩
  rw [AffAut.map_act, hQ, AffAut.act_inv_act]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.act_genericPoint_ne_zero
statement: lemma act_genericPoint_ne_zero (g : AffAut W) : g.act _ (genericPoint W) ≠ 0

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.transcendental_xOf_act

lemma transcendental_xOf_act (g : AffAut W) :

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.removedSetIn_subset
statement:
lemma removedSetIn_subset {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra k K] :
    removedSetIn W K ℓ M ⊆
      ⋃ m ∈ (M : Set W.toAffine.Point), (· + bc W K m) '' ((W.toAffine⁄K).torsion ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro P ⟨m, hm, h⟩
  exact Set.mem_biUnion hm ⟨P - bc W K m, mem_torsion_iff.mpr h, sub_add_cancel P _⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.removedSetIn_eq_torsion
statement:
lemma removedSetIn_eq_torsion {K : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra k K]
    (hM : ∀ m ∈ M, ℓ • m = 0) :
    removedSetIn W K ℓ M = ((W.toAffine⁄K).torsion ℓ : Set (W.toAffine⁄K).Point)
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_torsion_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, h⟩
    rwa [smul_sub, ← map_nsmul, hM m hm, map_zero, sub_zero] at h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨0, M.zero_mem, by rw [map_zero, sub_zero]; exact h⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.finite_geomRemovedSet_of_not_dvd_charP

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_isLocalization_geomOrbicurveRing

theorem exists_isLocalization_geomOrbicurveRing (hfin : (geomRemovedSet W ℓ M).Finite) :

    isGaloisStable_geomRemovedSet

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_coords_act
statement:
lemma exists_coords_act (g : AffAut W) (hm : g.m ≠ 0 → xOf g.m ∈ T) :
    ∃ X Y : ringOfX W T, ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [DecidableEq L] [Algebra k L]
      (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L), g.act L (pointOf χ) ≠ 0 ∧
        xOf (g.act L (pointOf χ)) = χ X ∧ yOf (g.act L (pointOf χ)) = χ Y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm0 : g.m = 0
  · exact ⟨_, _, fun L _ _ _ χ => act_pointOf_of_m_eq_zero χ g hm0⟩
  · exact ⟨_, _, fun L _ _ _ χ => act_pointOf χ g hm0 (hm hm0)⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringOfX_le
statement:
lemma ringOfX_le {B : Subalgebra k (funField W)} (hx : xGen W ∈ B) (hy : yGen W ∈ B)
    (hT : ∀ a ∈ T, (xGen W - algebraMap k (funField W) a)⁻¹ ∈ B) : ringOfX W T ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
  rintro _ ((rfl | rfl) | ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
  exacts [hx, hy, hT a ha]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.locMapInv_algebraMap
statement:
lemma locMapInv_algebraMap (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    locMapInv hD ⟨algebraMap _ (funField W) c, algebraMap_mem_range_locMap hD c⟩ =

proof:
:= by

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.evalRingOfX_algebraMap
statement:
lemma evalRingOfX_algebraMap {Q : GeomPoint W} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hQD : evalPt hQ D ≠ 0)
    (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) (hc : algebraMap _ (funField W) c ∈ ringOfX W T) :
    evalRingOfX hD hT hQ hQD ⟨_, hc⟩ = evalPt hQ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalRingOfX, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply]
  have : Subalgebra.inclusion hT ⟨_, hc⟩ =
      ⟨algebraMap _ (funField W) c, algebraMap_mem_range_locMap hD c⟩ := rfl
  rw [this, locMapInv_algebraMap, evalLoc_algebraMap]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pointOf_evalRingOfX
statement:
lemma pointOf_evalRingOfX {Q : GeomPoint W} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hQD : evalPt hQ D ≠ 0) :
    pointOf (evalRingOfX hD hT hQ hQD) = Q
proof:
:= by
  refine Point.ext_xOf_yOf (pointOf_ne_zero _) hQ ?_ ?_
  · rw [xOf_pointOf]
    exact (evalRingOfX_algebraMap hD hT hQ hQD (xC W) xGen_mem_ringOfX).trans (evalPt_xC hQ)
  · rw [yOf_pointOf]
    exact (evalRingOfX_algebraMap hD hT hQ hQD (yC W) yGen_mem_ringOfX).trans (evalPt_yC hQ)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_pullback_eq
statement:
theorem exists_pullback_eq (g : AffAut W) (hm : g.m ≠ 0 → xOf g.m ∈ T)
    (h : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    ∃ (a : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) (N : ℕ),
      pullback W g (algebraMap _ _ h) =
        algebraMap _ (funField W) a * (algebraMap _ (funField W) D)⁻¹ ^ N ∧
      ∀ (Q : GeomPoint W) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (_ : evalPt hQ D ≠ 0),
        ∃ hgQ : g.act _ Q ≠ 0, evalPt hQ a = evalPt hgQ h * evalPt hQ D ^ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hXY⟩ := exists_coords_act g hm
  obtain ⟨hne, hx, hy⟩ := hXY (funField W) (ringOfX W T).val
  rw [pointOf_val] at hne hx hy
  have heq : (W.toAffine⁄(ringOfX W T)).Equation X Y :=
    (W.toAffine.baseChange_equation (f := (ringOfX W T).val) Subtype.val_injective X Y).mp
      (by rw [← hx, ← hy]; exact equation_xOf_yOf hne)
  set Φ := evalHom W X Y heq
  have hΦ : (ringOfX W T).val.comp Φ =
      (pullback W g).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k _ (funField W)) := by
    refine coordRing_algHom_ext ?_ ?_
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Φ, evalHom_xC, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom',
        algebraMap_xC, pullback_xGen]
      exact hx.symm
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Φ, evalHom_yC, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom',
        algebraMap_yC, pullback_yGen]
      exact hy.symm
  have hw : ((Φ h : ringOfX W T) : funField W) = pullback W g (algebraMap _ _ h) :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hΦ h
  obtain ⟨a, N, hz⟩ := exists_mk' (locMapInv hD (Subalgebra.inclusion hT (Φ h)))
  have hlz := locMap_locMapInv hD (Subalgebra.inclusion hT (Φ h))
  rw [hz, locMap_mk'] at hlz
  refine ⟨a, N, by rw [← hw, hlz]; rfl, fun Q hQ hQD => ?_⟩
  set χ := evalRingOfX hD hT hQ hQD
  have hχ := pointOf_evalRingOfX hD hT hQ hQD
  obtain ⟨hgQ, hgx, hgy⟩ := hXY (AlgebraicClosure k) χ
  rw [hχ] at hgQ hgx hgy
  refine ⟨hgQ, ?_⟩
  have h1 : evalPt hgQ h = χ (Φ h) := by
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply χ Φ, comp_evalHom, evalPt, evalHom_congr _ hgx hgy]
  have h2 : χ (Φ h) = evalLoc (evalPt hQ) hQD
      (IsLocalization.mk' _ a (⟨D ^ N, N, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers D)) := by
    rw [← hz]
    rfl
  rw [h1, h2, evalLoc_mk'_mul]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.inv_algebraMap_pow_mem_ringAway
statement:
lemma inv_algebraMap_pow_mem_ringAway {𝒮 : Set (GeomPoint W)} (hD𝒮 : zeroSet W D ⊆ 𝒮)
    (N : ℕ) : (algebraMap _ (funField W) D)⁻¹ ^ N ∈ ringAway W 𝒮
proof:
:=
  pow_mem (inv_mem_ringAway hD𝒮) N

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pullback_mem_ringAway_aux
proof:
:= by
  suffices ringAway W 𝒮 ≤ (ringAway W 𝒮).comap (pullback W g) from this hf
  refine ringAway_le (fun c => ?_) (fun h hh => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨a, N, ha, -⟩ := exists_pullback_eq hD hT g hm c
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_comap, ha]
    exact mul_mem (algebraMap_mem_ringAway a) (inv_algebraMap_pow_mem_ringAway hD𝒮 N)
  · obtain ⟨a, N, ha, hev⟩ := exists_pullback_eq hD hT g hm h
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_comap, map_inv₀, ha, mul_inv, inv_pow, inv_inv]
    refine mul_mem (inv_mem_ringAway fun Q hQ => ?_) (pow_mem (algebraMap_mem_ringAway D) N)
    obtain ⟨hQ0, hQa⟩ := hQ
    by_cases hQD : evalPt hQ0 D = 0
    · exact hD𝒮 ⟨hQ0, hQD⟩
    obtain ⟨hgQ, hev⟩ := hev Q hQ0 hQD
    rw [hQa, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_left (pow_ne_zero _ hQD)] at hev
    have := hg _ (hh ⟨hgQ, hev⟩)
    rwa [AffAut.act_inv_act] at this

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xC_sub_ne_zero
statement: lemma xC_sub_ne_zero (a : k) : xC W - algebraMap k W.toAffine.CoordinateRing a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply xGen_sub_ne_zero W a
  have := congrArg (algebraMap _ (funField W)) h
  rwa [map_sub, algebraMap_xC, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, map_zero] at this

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pullback_mem_ringAway
statement:
theorem pullback_mem_ringAway {𝒮 : Set (GeomPoint W)} {g : AffAut W}
    (hg : ∀ P ∈ 𝒮, g⁻¹.act _ P ∈ 𝒮)
    (hm : g.m ≠ 0 → bc W (AlgebraicClosure k) g.m ∈ 𝒮 ∧ -bc W (AlgebraicClosure k) g.m ∈ 𝒮)
    {f : funField W} (hf : f ∈ ringAway W 𝒮) : pullback W g f ∈ ringAway W 𝒮
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm0 : g.m = 0
  · have hT : ringOfX W ∅ ≤ (locMap (1 : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) one_ne_zero).range :=
      ringOfX_le (algebraMap_mem_range_locMap _ (xC W))
        (algebraMap_mem_range_locMap _ (yC W)) (fun a ha => ha.elim)
    exact pullback_mem_ringAway_aux one_ne_zero hT (by rw [zeroSet_one]; exact Set.empty_subset _)
      (fun h => absurd hm0 h) hg hf
  · set D := xC W - algebraMap k W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (xOf g.m)
    have hD : D ≠ 0 := xC_sub_ne_zero _
    have hιD : algebraMap _ (funField W) D = xGen W - algebraMap k (funField W) (xOf g.m) := by
      rw [map_sub, algebraMap_xC, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
    have hT : ringOfX W {xOf g.m} ≤ (locMap D hD).range :=
      ringOfX_le (algebraMap_mem_range_locMap _ (xC W)) (algebraMap_mem_range_locMap _ (yC W))
        (fun a ha => by rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha, ← hιD]; exact inv_mem_range_locMap hD)
    refine pullback_mem_ringAway_aux hD hT (fun Q hQ => ?_) (fun _ => rfl) hg hf
    obtain ⟨hQ0, hQx⟩ := (mem_zeroSet_xC_sub _).mp hQ
    have hbc : bc W (AlgebraicClosure k) g.m ≠ 0 := by rwa [Ne, bc_eq_zero_iff]
    have hpm : Q = bc W _ g.m ∨ Q = -bc W _ g.m := by
      rw [eq_some_xOf_yOf hQ0, eq_some_xOf_yOf hbc]
      exact Point.X_eq_iff.mp (by rw [hQx, xOf_bc])
    rcases hpm with rfl | rfl
    exacts [(hm hm0).1, (hm hm0).2]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.smul_mem_ringAway
statement:
lemma smul_mem_ringAway (g : A) {f : funField W} (hf : f ∈ ringAway W 𝒮) :
    (g : AffAut W) • f ∈ ringAway W 𝒮
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_funField_def]
  refine pullback_mem_ringAway (fun P hP => ?_) (fun hm => ?_) hf
  · rw [inv_inv]
    exact IsAffStableGeom.act_mem _ g.2 P hP
  · have := IsAffStableGeom.bc_mem (W := W) (𝒮 := 𝒮) _ (A.inv_mem g.2) hm
    exact ⟨this, IsAffStableGeom.neg_mem (A := A) _ this⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coe_smul_ringAway
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_smul_ringAway (g : A) (r : ringAway W 𝒮) :
    ((g • r : ringAway W 𝒮) : funField W) = (g : AffAut W) • (r : funField W)
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.zero_mem_removedSetIn
statement: lemma zero_mem_removedSetIn : (0 : (W.toAffine⁄K).Point) ∈ removedSetIn W K ℓ M
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, M.zero_mem, by rw [map_zero, sub_zero, smul_zero]⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.neg_mem_removedSetIn
statement:
lemma neg_mem_removedSetIn {P : (W.toAffine⁄K).Point} (hP : P ∈ removedSetIn W K ℓ M) :
    -P ∈ removedSetIn W K ℓ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, h⟩ := hP
  refine ⟨-m, M.neg_mem hm, ?_⟩
  rw [map_neg, neg_sub_neg, ← neg_sub, smul_neg, h, neg_zero]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.act_mem_removedSetIn
statement:
lemma act_mem_removedSetIn {pm : Bool} {g : AffAut W} (hg : g ∈ affGroup W M pm)
    {P : (W.toAffine⁄K).Point} (hP : P ∈ removedSetIn W K ℓ M) :
    g.act K P ∈ removedSetIn W K ℓ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, h⟩ := hP
  refine ⟨g.ε • m + g.m, M.add_mem ?_ hg.1, ?_⟩
  · rw [Units.smul_def]
    exact M.zsmul_mem hm _
  · rw [AffAut.act_def, map_add, bc_units_smul, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← smul_sub,
      smul_comm, h, smul_zero]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.bc_mem_removedSetIn
statement:
lemma bc_mem_removedSetIn {m : W.toAffine.Point} (hm : m ∈ M) :
    bc W K m ∈ removedSetIn W K ℓ M
proof:
:=
  ⟨m, hm, by rw [sub_self, smul_zero]⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.bc_mem_removedSetIn_iff
statement:
lemma bc_mem_removedSetIn_iff {P : W.toAffine.Point} :
    bc W K P ∈ removedSetIn W K ℓ M ↔ P ∈ removedSet W ℓ M
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_congr fun m => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
  rw [← map_sub, ← map_nsmul, bc_eq_zero_iff]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.mem_affGroup
statement:
lemma mem_affGroup {M : AddSubgroup W.toAffine.Point} {pm : Bool} {g : AffAut W} :
    g ∈ affGroup W M pm ↔ g.m ∈ M ∧ (pm = false → g.ε = 1)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.removedSet_eq_torsionSet
statement:
lemma removedSet_eq_torsionSet {ℓ : ℕ} {M : AddSubgroup W.toAffine.Point}
    (hM : ∀ m ∈ M, ℓ • m = 0) : removedSet W ℓ M = torsionSet W ℓ
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, h⟩
    change ℓ • P = 0
    rw [smul_sub, hM m hm, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨0, M.zero_mem, by rw [sub_zero]; exact h⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.isAffStable_torsionSet
proof:
:= by
  rw [← removedSet_eq_torsionSet hM]
  infer_instance

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.isUnit_of_forall_algHom_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hu
  obtain ⟨𝔪, h𝔪, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal (Ideal.span {u})
    (by rwa [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top])
  letI : Field (R ⧸ 𝔪) := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔪
  haveI : Module.Finite k (R ⧸ 𝔪) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing k (R ⧸ 𝔪)
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (R ⧸ 𝔪) := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite k _
  apply h ((IsAlgClosed.lift : (R ⧸ 𝔪) →ₐ[k] AlgebraicClosure k).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k 𝔪))
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hle (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self u)), map_zero]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.orbicurveOrbifold_R
statement:
lemma orbicurveOrbifold_R (ℓ : ℕ) (M : AddSubgroup W.toAffine.Point) (pm : Bool) :
    (orbicurveOrbifold W ℓ M pm).R = geomOrbicurveRing W ℓ M
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.units_smul_ne_zero
statement: lemma units_smul_ne_zero (ε : ℤˣ) {Q : V.Point} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) : ε • Q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or ε with rfl | rfl
  · rwa [one_smul]
  · rwa [Units.neg_smul, one_smul, neg_ne_zero]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xOf_units_smul
statement: lemma xOf_units_smul (ε : ℤˣ) (Q : V.Point) : xOf (ε • Q) = xOf Q
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or ε with rfl | rfl
  · rw [one_smul]
  · rw [Units.neg_smul, one_smul]
    cases Q with
    | zero => rfl
    | some x y h => rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.yOf_units_smul
statement:
lemma yOf_units_smul (ε : ℤˣ) (Q : V.Point) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) :
    yOf (ε • Q) = if ε = 1 then yOf Q else V.negY (xOf Q) (yOf Q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or ε with rfl | rfl
  · rw [one_smul, if_pos rfl]
  · rw [Units.neg_smul, one_smul, if_neg (by decide)]
    cases Q with
    | zero => exact absurd rfl hQ
    | some x y h => rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.add_of_xOf_ne
statement:
lemma add_of_xOf_ne {P R : V.Point} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hx : xOf P ≠ xOf R) :
    P + R ≠ 0 ∧
      xOf (P + R) = V.addX (xOf P) (xOf R) ((yOf P - yOf R) / (xOf P - xOf R)) ∧
      yOf (P + R) = V.addY (xOf P) (xOf R) (yOf P) ((yOf P - yOf R) / (xOf P - xOf R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_some_xOf_yOf hP, eq_some_xOf_yOf hR, Point.add_of_X_ne hx]
  refine ⟨Point.some_ne_zero _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [xOf_some, slope_of_X_ne hx]
    rfl
  · rw [yOf_some, slope_of_X_ne hx]
    rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xOf_mem_xSet
statement:
lemma xOf_mem_xSet [DecidableEq k] {S : Set W.toAffine.Point} {P : W.toAffine.Point}
    (hPS : P ∈ S) (hP : P ≠ 0) : xOf P ∈ xSet W S
proof:
:=
  ⟨P, ⟨hPS, hP⟩, rfl⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xSet_finite
statement:
lemma xSet_finite [DecidableEq k] {S : Set W.toAffine.Point} (hS : S.Finite) :
    (xSet W S).Finite
proof:
:=
  (hS.sdiff).image _

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xGen_mem_ringOfX
statement: lemma xGen_mem_ringOfX : xGen W ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl (Set.mem_insert _ _))

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.yGen_mem_ringOfX
statement: lemma yGen_mem_ringOfX : yGen W ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.inv_mem_ringOfX
statement:
lemma inv_mem_ringOfX {a : k} (ha : a ∈ T) :
    (xGen W - algebraMap k (funField W) a)⁻¹ ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringOfX_mono
statement: lemma ringOfX_mono (h : T ⊆ T') : ringOfX W T ≤ ringOfX W T'
proof:
:=
  Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.union_subset_union_right _ (Set.image_mono h))

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringOfX_fg
statement: lemma ringOfX_fg (hT : T.Finite) : (ringOfX W T).FG
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.fg_def.mpr ⟨_, ((Set.toFinite _).union (hT.image _)), rfl⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringOf_fg
statement: lemma ringOf_fg [DecidableEq k] {S : Set W.toAffine.Point} (hS : S.Finite) : (ringOf W S).FG
proof:
:=
  ringOfX_fg (xSet_finite hS)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xGen_sub_ne_zero
statement: lemma xGen_sub_ne_zero (a : k) : xGen W - algebraMap k (funField W) a ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h => by
  apply transcendental_xGen W
  rw [sub_eq_zero.mp h]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap a

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.algebraMap_mem_ringOfX
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mem_ringOfX (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    algebraMap W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (funField W) c ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := AdjoinRoot.mk_surjective c
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on with
  | C q =>
    induction q using Polynomial.induction_on with
    | C a =>
      rw [← algebraMap_funField]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ a
    | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [C_add, map_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem hp hq
    | monomial n a ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, C_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
      exact mul_mem ih xGen_mem_ringOfX
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact add_mem hp hq
  | monomial n q ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, map_mul, map_mul]
    exact mul_mem ih yGen_mem_ringOfX

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coe_xR
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_xR : (xR W T : funField W) = xGen W
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coe_yR
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_yR : (yR W T : funField W) = yGen W
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.invR_mul
statement: lemma invR_mul {a : k} (ha : a ∈ T) : invR ha * (xR W T - algebraMap k _ a) = 1
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel₀ (xGen_sub_ne_zero W a))

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.isUnit_xR_sub
statement: lemma isUnit_xR_sub {a : k} (ha : a ∈ T) : IsUnit (xR W T - algebraMap k _ a)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_iff_exists_inv'.mpr ⟨invR ha, invR_mul ha⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.equation_R
statement: lemma equation_R : (W.toAffine⁄(ringOfX W T)).Equation (xR W T) (yR W T)
proof:
:=
  (W.toAffine.baseChange_equation (f := (ringOfX W T).val) Subtype.val_injective _ _).mp
    (equation_gen W)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pointOf_ne_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma pointOf_ne_zero (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) : pointOf χ ≠ 0
proof: := Point.some_ne_zero _

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xOf_pointOf
statement: @[simp] lemma xOf_pointOf (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) : xOf (pointOf χ) = χ (xR W T)
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.yOf_pointOf
statement: @[simp] lemma yOf_pointOf (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) : yOf (pointOf χ) = χ (yR W T)
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pointOf_val
statement: lemma pointOf_val : pointOf (ringOfX W T).val = genericPoint W
proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xOf_pointOf_ne
statement:
lemma xOf_pointOf_ne (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) {a : k} (ha : a ∈ T) :
    xOf (pointOf χ) ≠ algebraMap k L a
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := congrArg χ (invR_mul ha)
  rw [map_mul, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, map_one, ← xOf_pointOf, h, sub_self, mul_zero] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.yOf_units_smul_pointOf
statement:
lemma yOf_units_smul_pointOf (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) (ε : ℤˣ) :
    yOf (ε • pointOf χ) = χ (yεR T ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [yOf_units_smul _ _ (pointOf_ne_zero χ), yεR]
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact (W.toAffine.baseChange_negY χ _ _)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.act_pointOf
statement:
theorem act_pointOf (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) (g : AffAut W) (hm0 : g.m ≠ 0)
    (hm : xOf g.m ∈ T) :
    g.act L (pointOf χ) ≠ 0 ∧ xOf (g.act L (pointOf χ)) = χ (g.xR hm) ∧
      yOf (g.act L (pointOf χ)) = χ (g.yR hm)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := units_smul_ne_zero g.ε (pointOf_ne_zero χ)
  have hR : bc W L g.m ≠ 0 := by rwa [Ne, bc_eq_zero_iff]
  have hxP : xOf (g.ε • pointOf χ) = χ (xR W T) := by rw [xOf_units_smul, xOf_pointOf]
  have hyP := yOf_units_smul_pointOf χ g.ε
  have hxR : xOf (bc W L g.m) = χ (algebraMap k _ (xOf g.m)) := by
    rw [xOf_bc, AlgHom.commutes]
  have hyR : yOf (bc W L g.m) = χ (algebraMap k _ (yOf g.m)) := by
    rw [yOf_bc, AlgHom.commutes]
  have hne : xOf (g.ε • pointOf χ) ≠ xOf (bc W L g.m) := by
    rw [xOf_units_smul, xOf_bc]
    exact xOf_pointOf_ne χ hm
  have hslope : (yOf (g.ε • pointOf χ) - yOf (bc W L g.m)) /
      (xOf (g.ε • pointOf χ) - xOf (bc W L g.m)) = χ (g.slopeR hm) := by
    have hinv := congrArg χ (invR_mul hm)
    rw [map_mul, map_one] at hinv
    rw [AffAut.slopeR, map_mul, hyP, hyR, hxP, hxR, ← map_sub, ← map_sub,
      eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hinv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  obtain ⟨h0, hx, hy⟩ := add_of_xOf_ne hP hR hne
  rw [hslope, hxP, hxR] at hx
  rw [hslope, hxP, hxR, hyP] at hy
  refine ⟨h0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [AffAut.act_def, hx, AffAut.xR, baseChange_addX]
  · rw [AffAut.act_def, hy, AffAut.yR, baseChange_addY]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.act_pointOf_of_m_eq_zero
statement:
theorem act_pointOf_of_m_eq_zero (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) (g : AffAut W) (hm0 : g.m = 0) :
    g.act L (pointOf χ) ≠ 0 ∧ xOf (g.act L (pointOf χ)) = χ (xR W T) ∧
      yOf (g.act L (pointOf χ)) = χ (yεR T g.ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffAut.act_def, hm0, map_zero, add_zero]
  exact ⟨units_smul_ne_zero g.ε (pointOf_ne_zero χ), by rw [xOf_units_smul, xOf_pointOf],
    yOf_units_smul_pointOf χ g.ε⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coords_act_genericPoint_mem
statement:
theorem coords_act_genericPoint_mem (g : AffAut W) (hm : g.m ≠ 0 → xOf g.m ∈ T) :
    xOf (g.act _ (genericPoint W)) ∈ ringOfX W T ∧
      yOf (g.act _ (genericPoint W)) ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pointOf_val (T := T)]
  by_cases hm0 : g.m = 0
  · obtain ⟨-, hx, hy⟩ := act_pointOf_of_m_eq_zero (ringOfX W T).val g hm0
    rw [hx, hy]
    exact ⟨Subtype.prop _, Subtype.prop _⟩
  · obtain ⟨-, hx, hy⟩ := act_pointOf (ringOfX W T).val g hm0 (hm hm0)
    rw [hx, hy]
    exact ⟨Subtype.prop _, Subtype.prop _⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pullback_xGen_mem
statement:
lemma pullback_xGen_mem (g : AffAut W) (hm : g.m ≠ 0 → xOf g.m ∈ T) :
    pullback W g (xGen W) ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullback_xGen]
  exact (coords_act_genericPoint_mem g hm).1

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pullback_yGen_mem
statement:
lemma pullback_yGen_mem (g : AffAut W) (hm : g.m ≠ 0 → xOf g.m ∈ T) :
    pullback W g (yGen W) ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullback_yGen]
  exact (coords_act_genericPoint_mem g hm).2

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.false_of_pointOf_eq_bc
statement:
lemma false_of_pointOf_eq_bc {L : Type*} [Field L] [DecidableEq L] [Algebra k L]
    (χ : ringOfX W T →ₐ[k] L) {Q : W.toAffine.Point} (hQ : Q ≠ 0 → xOf Q ∈ T)
    (h : pointOf χ = bc W L Q) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := fun h0 => pointOf_ne_zero χ (by rw [h, h0, map_zero])
  apply xOf_pointOf_ne χ (hQ hQ0)
  rw [h, xOf_bc]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.isUnit_xR_sub_of_finite
statement:
theorem isUnit_xR_sub_of_finite (hT : T.Finite) (g : AffAut W) (hm0 : g.m ≠ 0)
    (hm : xOf g.m ∈ T) {P : W.toAffine.Point} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : g⁻¹ • P ≠ 0 → xOf (g⁻¹ • P) ∈ T) (h₂ : g⁻¹ • (-P) ≠ 0 → xOf (g⁻¹ • (-P)) ∈ T) :
    IsUnit (g.xR hm - algebraMap k (ringOfX W T) (xOf P))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k (ringOfX W T) :=
    (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType (ringOfX W T)).mp (ringOfX_fg hT)
  refine isUnit_of_forall_algHom_ne_zero (k := k) fun χ hχ => ?_
  obtain ⟨h0, hx, -⟩ := act_pointOf χ g hm0 hm
  rw [map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, ← hx, sub_eq_zero] at hχ
  have hbc : bc W (AlgebraicClosure k) P ≠ 0 := by rwa [Ne, bc_eq_zero_iff]
  have hpm : g.act _ (pointOf χ) = bc W _ P ∨ g.act _ (pointOf χ) = -bc W _ P := by
    rw [eq_some_xOf_yOf h0, eq_some_xOf_yOf hbc]
    exact Point.X_eq_iff.mp (by rw [hχ, xOf_bc])
  rcases hpm with hpm | hpm
  · refine false_of_pointOf_eq_bc χ h₁ ?_
    rw [AffAut.bc_smul, ← hpm, AffAut.act_inv_act]
  · refine false_of_pointOf_eq_bc χ h₂ ?_
    rw [AffAut.bc_smul, map_neg, ← hpm, AffAut.act_inv_act]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.inv_coe_mem_of_isUnit
statement:
lemma inv_coe_mem_of_isUnit {B : Subalgebra k (funField W)} {u : B} (hu : IsUnit u) :
    (u : funField W)⁻¹ ∈ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hu
  have : ((v⁻¹ : Bˣ) : funField W) * (v : B) = 1 := congrArg Subtype.val v.inv_mul
  rw [← eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left this]
  exact Subtype.prop _

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.inv_pullback_mem
statement:
theorem inv_pullback_mem (g : AffAut W) (hm : g.m ≠ 0 → xOf g.m ∈ T) {P : W.toAffine.Point}
    (hP : P ≠ 0) (h₁ : g⁻¹ • P ≠ 0 → xOf (g⁻¹ • P) ∈ T)
    (h₂ : g⁻¹ • (-P) ≠ 0 → xOf (g⁻¹ • (-P)) ∈ T) :
    (pullback W g (xGen W - algebraMap k (funField W) (xOf P)))⁻¹ ∈ ringOfX W T
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, pullback_xGen, ← pointOf_val (T := T)]
  by_cases hm0 : g.m = 0
  · obtain ⟨-, hx, -⟩ := act_pointOf_of_m_eq_zero (ringOfX W T).val g hm0
    have hginv : g⁻¹ • P = g.ε⁻¹ • P := by
      rw [AffAut.smul_def, AffAut.inv_ε, AffAut.inv_m, hm0, smul_zero, neg_zero, add_zero]
    have hgP : g⁻¹ • P ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hginv]
      exact units_smul_ne_zero _ hP
    have hT := h₁ hgP
    rw [hginv, xOf_units_smul] at hT
    rw [hx]
    exact inv_mem_ringOfX hT
  · set T' : Set k := {a ∈ T | a = xOf g.m ∨ a = xOf (g⁻¹ • P) ∨ a = xOf (g⁻¹ • (-P))}
    have hT'T : T' ⊆ T := fun a ha => ha.1
    have hT' : T'.Finite := (Set.toFinite {xOf g.m, xOf (g⁻¹ • P), xOf (g⁻¹ • (-P))}).subset
      fun a ha => by simpa using ha.2
    have hmT' : xOf g.m ∈ T' := ⟨hm hm0, Or.inl rfl⟩
    have hu := isUnit_xR_sub_of_finite hT' g hm0 hmT' hP
      (fun h => ⟨h₁ h, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩) (fun h => ⟨h₂ h, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)⟩)
    obtain ⟨-, hx, -⟩ := act_pointOf (ringOfX W T').val g hm0 hmT'
    have hmem := inv_coe_mem_of_isUnit hu
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_sub, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, ← Subalgebra.coe_val, ← hx,
      pointOf_val] at hmem
    rw [pointOf_val]
    exact ringOfX_mono hT'T hmem

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.pullback_mem_ringOf
statement:
theorem pullback_mem_ringOf {S : Set W.toAffine.Point} (h0 : 0 ∈ S)
    (hneg : ∀ P ∈ S, -P ∈ S) {g : AffAut W} (hg : ∀ P ∈ S, g • P ∈ S)
    (hg' : ∀ P ∈ S, g⁻¹ • P ∈ S) {f : funField W} (hf : f ∈ ringOf W S) :
    pullback W g f ∈ ringOf W S
proof:
:= by
  have hm : g.m ≠ 0 → xOf g.m ∈ xSet W S := fun hm0 => by
    have := hg 0 h0
    rw [AffAut.smul_def, smul_zero, zero_add] at this
    exact xOf_mem_xSet this hm0
  suffices ringOf W S ≤ (ringOf W S).comap (pullback W g) from this hf
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
  rintro _ ((rfl | rfl) | ⟨a, ⟨P, ⟨hPS, hP0⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
  · exact pullback_xGen_mem g hm
  · exact pullback_yGen_mem g hm
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subalgebra.mem_comap, map_inv₀]
    exact inv_pullback_mem g hm hP0 (fun h => xOf_mem_xSet (hg' P hPS) h)
      (fun h => xOf_mem_xSet (hg' _ (hneg P hPS)) h)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.smul_mem_ringOf
statement:
lemma smul_mem_ringOf (g : A) {f : funField W} (hf : f ∈ ringOf W S) :
    (g : AffAut W) • f ∈ ringOf W S
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_funField_def]
  refine pullback_mem_ringOf (IsAffStable.zero_mem (A := A)) (IsAffStable.neg_mem (A := A))
    (IsAffStable.smul_mem _ (A.inv_mem g.2)) (fun P hP => ?_) hf
  rw [inv_inv]
  exact IsAffStable.smul_mem _ g.2 P hP

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coe_smul_ringOf
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_smul_ringOf (g : A) (r : ringOf W S) :

proof: := rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.algebraMap_xC

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.algebraMap_yC

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.coordRing_algHom_ext

lemma coordRing_algHom_ext {φ ψ : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing →ₐ[k] A}

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.evalHom_xC
statement: lemma evalHom_xC (x y : A) (h : (W.toAffine⁄A).Equation x y) : evalHom W x y h (xC W) = x

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.comp_evalHom

lemma comp_evalHom (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (x y : A) (h : (W.toAffine⁄A).Equation x y) :

proof:
:=

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.equation_C
statement: lemma equation_C : (W.toAffine⁄W.toAffine.CoordinateRing).Equation (xC W) (yC W)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.eq_evalHom

lemma eq_evalHom (φ : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing →ₐ[k] A) :

proof:
:=

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.evalPt_algebraMap_polynomial

@[simp] lemma evalPt_algebraMap_polynomial {Q : (W.toAffine⁄L).Point} (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (p : k[X]) :

lemma pointOfC_ne_zero [W.IsElliptic] (φ : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing →ₐ[k] L) :

lemma evalPt_pointOfC [W.IsElliptic] (φ : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing →ₐ[k] L) :

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.mem_zeroSet
statement:
lemma mem_zeroSet {h : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing} {Q : GeomPoint W} :
    Q ∈ zeroSet W h ↔ ∃ hQ : Q ≠ 0, evalPt hQ h = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ne_zero_of_mem_zeroSet
statement:
lemma ne_zero_of_mem_zeroSet {h : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing} {Q : GeomPoint W}
    (hQ : Q ∈ zeroSet W h) : Q ≠ 0

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.zero_notMem_zeroSet
statement: lemma zero_notMem_zeroSet (h : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) : (0 : GeomPoint W) ∉ zeroSet W h
proof:
:=
  fun hQ => hQ.1 rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.zeroSet_mul
statement:
lemma zeroSet_mul (a b : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    zeroSet W (a * b) = zeroSet W a ∪ zeroSet W b
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  simp only [Set.mem_union, mem_zeroSet, map_mul, mul_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hQ, h | h⟩
    exacts [Or.inl ⟨hQ, h⟩, Or.inr ⟨hQ, h⟩]
  · rintro (⟨hQ, h⟩ | ⟨hQ, h⟩)
    exacts [⟨hQ, Or.inl h⟩, ⟨hQ, Or.inr h⟩]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.zeroSet_pow
statement:
lemma zeroSet_pow (a : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    zeroSet W (a ^ n) = zeroSet W a
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  simp only [mem_zeroSet, map_pow, pow_eq_zero_iff hn]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.zeroSet_one
statement: lemma zeroSet_one : zeroSet W 1 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  simp [mem_zeroSet]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.mem_zeroSet_xC_sub
statement:
lemma mem_zeroSet_xC_sub (a : k) {Q : GeomPoint W} :
    Q ∈ zeroSet W (xC W - algebraMap k _ a) ↔ Q ≠ 0 ∧ xOf Q = algebraMap k _ a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_zeroSet, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes, evalPt_xC, sub_eq_zero, exists_prop]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.algebraMap_mem_ringAway
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mem_ringAway (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    algebraMap _ (funField W) c ∈ ringAway W 𝒮
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨c, rfl⟩)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.inv_mem_ringAway
statement:
lemma inv_mem_ringAway {h : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing} (hh : zeroSet W h ⊆ 𝒮) :
    (algebraMap _ (funField W) h)⁻¹ ∈ ringAway W 𝒮
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringAway_mono
statement: lemma ringAway_mono (h : 𝒮 ⊆ 𝒮') : ringAway W 𝒮 ≤ ringAway W 𝒮'
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.union_subset_union_right _ ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨g, hg.trans h, rfl⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.ringAway_le
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
  rintro _ (⟨c, rfl⟩ | ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩)
  exacts [h₁ c, h₂ h hh]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.xGen_mem_ringAway
statement: lemma xGen_mem_ringAway : xGen W ∈ ringAway W 𝒮
proof: := algebraMap_mem_ringAway (xC W)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.yGen_mem_ringAway
statement: lemma yGen_mem_ringAway : yGen W ∈ ringAway W 𝒮
proof: := algebraMap_mem_ringAway (yC W)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.isUnit_algebraMap_of_mem_powers
statement:
lemma isUnit_algebraMap_of_mem_powers {D : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing} (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (y : Submonoid.powers D) :
    IsUnit (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k W.toAffine.CoordinateRing (funField W) y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := y.2
  rw [IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', ← hn, map_pow]
  exact (IsUnit.mk0 _ ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (injective_algebraMap_funField W)).mpr hD)).pow n

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.locMap_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma locMap_algebraMap (hD : D ≠ 0) (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    locMap D hD (algebraMap _ _ c) = algebraMap _ (funField W) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [locMap, IsLocalization.liftAlgHom_apply, IsLocalization.lift_eq]
  rfl

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.locMap_mk'
statement:
lemma locMap_mk' (hD : D ≠ 0) (a : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) (n : ℕ) :
    locMap D hD (IsLocalization.mk' _ a (⟨D ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers D)) =
      algebraMap _ (funField W) a * (algebraMap _ (funField W) D)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hD' : algebraMap _ (funField W) D ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (injective_algebraMap_funField W)).mpr hD
  have h := IsLocalization.mk'_spec (Localization.Away D) a
    (⟨D ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers D)
  have h' := congrArg (locMap D hD) h
  rw [map_mul, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, map_pow] at h'
  rw [inv_pow, eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hD'), h']

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.exists_mk'
statement:
lemma exists_mk' (z : Localization.Away D) :
    ∃ (a : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) (n : ℕ),
      z = IsLocalization.mk' _ a (⟨D ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers D) z
  exact ⟨a, n, rfl⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.injective_locMap
statement: lemma injective_locMap (hD : D ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (locMap D hD)
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun z hz => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, n, rfl⟩ := exists_mk' z
  have hD' : algebraMap _ (funField W) D ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (injective_algebraMap_funField W)).mpr hD
  rw [locMap_mk', mul_eq_zero, _root_.map_eq_zero_iff _ (injective_algebraMap_funField W)] at hz
  rcases hz with rfl | hz
  · exact IsLocalization.mk'_zero _
  · exact absurd hz (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hD'))

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.mem_range_locMap
statement:
lemma mem_range_locMap (hD : D ≠ 0) {f : funField W} :
    f ∈ (locMap D hD).range ↔ ∃ (a : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) (n : ℕ),
      f = algebraMap _ (funField W) a * (algebraMap _ (funField W) D)⁻¹ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, n, rfl⟩ := exists_mk' z
    exact ⟨a, n, locMap_mk' hD a n⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, locMap_mk' hD a n⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.algebraMap_mem_range_locMap
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mem_range_locMap (hD : D ≠ 0) (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) :
    algebraMap _ (funField W) c ∈ (locMap D hD).range
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, locMap_algebraMap hD c⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.inv_mem_range_locMap
statement:
lemma inv_mem_range_locMap (hD : D ≠ 0) :
    (algebraMap _ (funField W) D)⁻¹ ∈ (locMap D hD).range
proof:
:=
  (mem_range_locMap hD).mpr ⟨1, 1, by rw [map_one, one_mul, pow_one]⟩

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.locMap_locMapInv
statement:
@[simp] lemma locMap_locMapInv (hD : D ≠ 0) (f : (locMap D hD).range) :
    locMap D hD (locMapInv hD f) = f
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((AlgEquiv.ofInjective _ (injective_locMap hD)).apply_symm_apply f)

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.isUnit_of_mem_powers
statement:
lemma isUnit_of_mem_powers {φ : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing →ₐ[k] L} (hφ : φ D ≠ 0)
    (y : Submonoid.powers D) : IsUnit (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := y.2
  rw [← hn, map_pow]
  exact (IsUnit.mk0 _ hφ).pow n

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.evalLoc_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalLoc_algebraMap (φ : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing →ₐ[k] L) (hφ : φ D ≠ 0)
    (c : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) : evalLoc φ hφ (algebraMap _ _ c) = φ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalLoc, IsLocalization.liftAlgHom_apply, IsLocalization.lift_eq]

name: TemperedFundamentalGroups.Orbicurve.evalLoc_mk'_mul
statement:
lemma evalLoc_mk'_mul (φ : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing →ₐ[k] L) (hφ : φ D ≠ 0)
    (a : W.toAffine.CoordinateRing) (n : ℕ) :
    evalLoc φ hφ (IsLocalization.mk' _ a (⟨D ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers D)) * φ D ^ n =
      φ a
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (evalLoc φ hφ) (IsLocalization.mk'_spec (Localization.Away D) a
    (⟨D ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers D))
  rwa [map_mul, evalLoc_algebraMap, evalLoc_algebraMap, map_pow] at h

name: SemistableReduction.Node.u_mul_v
statement: lemma u_mul_v : u a * v a = algebraMap O (Node O a) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [u, v, ← map_mul, ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  exact Ideal.subset_span rfl

@[simp] lemma lift_u {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra O S] (x y : S)
    (h : x * y = algebraMap O S a) : lift x y h (u a) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, u]

name: SemistableReduction.Node.lift_v
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_v {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra O S] (x y : S)
    (h : x * y = algebraMap O S a) : lift x y h (v a) = y
proof:
:= by
